title: Plugin
description: One plugin as the agent reports it in agent_info. A plugin is an MCP server on the machine: a name, its tools and their inputs. Its tools are in tools/list, each named <plugin>_<tool>, with their input schemas; this says which tools are its, and what on the machine it uses.

tools.description: The names of its tools as offered in tools/list, each starting with the plugin's name and an underscore.

confirms.description: Which of its tools confirm a spoken yes. Each is also in tools. The hub calls one only for the voice, never for a Claude Code session; part of what Roy approves.

uses.description: What private thing on the machine the plugin can reach with its settings as they are now. Known in version 1: microphone, camera, location, calls, contacts, notifications, media, sensors, and usage, the use of the machine and its apps, such as data used. A later version may add more; a hub shows a value it does not know to Roy as unknown, and it needs his approval like any other. Part of what he approves: a setting that reaches more changes this, and Roy approves the plugin again.

instructions.description: The plugin's own rules for the voice, passed on with its tools.

examples.name: phone
examples.instructions: A number not on the phone's own list waits for a spoken yes.

examples.name: mobiledata
examples.instructions: Reads the phone's total mobile data, never any one app's.
